source_text.body:
Answer renter questions and schedule tours
EliseAI's leasing agent inside Zillow Rentals listings answers renter questions and schedules tours for multifamily partners.
Done with a
custom-built or unnamed agent
What they did
Zillow Rentals embeds an EliseAI-powered agent called AI Assist in its listings. It replies to renter inquiries from the first message, schedules tours, and follows up after tours, around the clock. That frees onsite leasing teams for residents. Zillow's multifamily partners with more than 450 units can use it.
How it went
From October 2025 to April 2026, renters who engaged with AI Assist were 43% more likely to apply, 19% more likely to book a tour and 24% more likely to sign a lease.
Worth knowing
This is a vendor press release. The comparison is between engaged leads in AI Assist buildings and leads in buildings without it, and it excludes buildings with instant touring enabled.
Try it yourself
with
Zapier Agents
Copy prompt
Build an agent for my rental listings at [property or company]. When a renter asks a question via [email/form/chat], answer it using [pricing, pet policy, amenities doc], and offer tour times from [calendar]. Escalate anything it can't answer to me. Before booking a tour or sending a reply, pause and show me for approval during testing. You're done when I've run three test inquiries.
Original source: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260611736825/en/EliseAI-and-Zillow-Rentals-Find-Renters-Who-Use-AI-Assist-Are-43-More-Likely-to-Apply
source_text.scope: Captured case text; external linked articles and HTML excluded.

translation.body:
回答租客问题并安排看房
嵌入 Zillow Rentals 房源页面的 EliseAI 租赁 agent，为多户住宅合作伙伴回答租客问题并安排看房。
实际使用
自建或未命名 agent
具体做法
Zillow Rentals 在房源页面中嵌入了一个由 EliseAI 提供支持、名为 AI Assist 的 agent。它从第一条消息开始回复租客咨询，安排看房，并在看房后跟进，全天候运行。这让现场租赁团队能腾出时间服务住户。Zillow 的多户住宅合作伙伴在拥有超过450套房源时可以使用它。
结果如何
从2025年10月到2026年4月，与 AI Assist 互动的租客申请租房的可能性高43%，预约看房的可能性高19%，签订租约的可能性高24%。
值得注意
这是一份供应商新闻稿。比较的是启用 AI Assist 的楼宇中与它互动的线索，和未启用它的楼宇中的线索；启用即时看房功能的楼宇被排除在外。
自行试用
推荐工具
Zapier Agents
复制提示词
为我在[物业或公司]的出租房源构建一个 agent。当租客通过[邮件/表单/聊天]提问时，使用[价格、宠物政策、配套设施文档]回答，并提供[日历]中的看房时段。将它无法回答的问题转交给我。测试期间，在预约看房或发送回复之前暂停，先向我展示并等待批准。当我完成三次测试咨询后，任务即告完成。
原始来源：https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260611736825/en/EliseAI-and-Zillow-Rentals-Find-Renters-Who-Use-AI-Assist-Are-43-More-Likely-to-Apply
translation.scope: Faithful full captured narrative, three relative likelihood claims, vendor/comparator/exclusion notes and complete Zapier Agents trial. Source actual custom/unnamed field retained while narrative identifies EliseAI AI Assist; suggested Zapier Agents not substituted. Archive October2025-April2026 period left unchanged; more precise original-footnote lead window discussed separately in research.
